assumptions: Circular concentric toroidal shells are an authored idealization; CAD supports, coil packs, divertor, coolant channels and structural reinforcement are not represented.
The 1.0 m plasma minor radius, radial layer thicknesses, clearance, 30-year exposure horizon and operating point are authored scaffold assumptions, not ARC as-built dimensions.

A finite axis-aligned 0.30 m by 0.30 m outboard void prism is explicitly modeled through the radial build. The transport worker estimates removed component volumes by independent OpenMC geometry sampling; its uncertainty is sampling uncertainty, not a rigorous geometric bound.

Materials are cold-data numerical surrogates: physical material temperatures are unspecified; data target 293.6 K resolves to the available approximately 293.595 K data. This does not model hot FLiBe or qualify temperature extrapolation.

Natural tungsten, reweighted 90%-Li6 Li2BeF4, crystalline-density TiH2, pure-Fe vessel surrogate and elemental copper magnet envelope are authored material representations, not certified industrial assays or components.

OpenMC transport responses are conditional on the stated source, geometry, materials, nuclear data and run artifact. Breeding, heating, spectra, exposure, service limits, component life and electricity are calculated only where the corresponding result artifact reports them; no result by itself qualifies a reactor design.
